results.snippet: Most app roundups for family caregivers describe a category that has already moved on. Medisafe capped its free tier at two medications in January. CareZone has been shut down for years and still shows up on lists.

results.snippet: TendTo does everything CareZone did — and works for the rest of caregiving too. CareZone shut down in 2023 after Walmart sunsetted the consumer app.

results.title: CareZone App, more than a simple medication management for families and caregivers | Health Apps for General Population | Medical Apps center | SteadyHealth.com
results.snippet: Caregivers can also add photos of important documents and instructions, and store them within the app. CareZone app is really easy to use, with beautiful, intuitive design. We encountered few 'hiccups' tho. App would occasionally freeze, requiring to shut it down or sometimes to log back in.
